title: On the largest common subtree of uniform attachment trees
summary: We study the largest common subtree of two independent unlabeled uniform attachment trees (also known as random recursive trees). Our main result shows that, when the two trees have $n$ vertices each, their largest common subtree has at least $n^{0.83}$ vertices with high probability. This is obtained by starting with the common subtree induced by the Ulam--Harris labels in the two trees and improving using local optimization steps.
